clips.title: The story
paras: Having delivered Brock Stoneseeker's missive to Ironforge, you are entrusted with a batch of Honorary Picks to carry back to Thelsamar. Taking advantage of the dwarven aerial transit network, you board a gryphon with Gryth Thurden to return quickly across the mountains.

The great mountain stronghold of Ironforge relies on a coordinated network of gryphon roosts to maintain communication and trade with outlying settlements like Loch Modan. Gryth Thurden, Ironforge's gryphon master, oversees this transit from the city's central flight master platform. Because travelers must first establish a rapport with an aerie's handler before flying there, Gryth ensures you have already spoken with Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar before saddling a mount for the return trip.

Your journey serves a practical purpose beyond introducing you to gryphon travel: Brock Stoneseeker, a respected mining instructor in Thelsamar, needs new equipment for his apprentices. With the Honorary Picks safely delivered to his hands, young miners across the valley can begin working the rich copper and tin veins that line the hills surrounding the Loch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... As long as you've already been there. Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.
You've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him. And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.
Speak with me when you're ready to go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, friend. Have you returned from Ironforge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought the picks. Great! I'll get these to my mining students. I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.
Thank you for your help, friend. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
